subject.title: [Feature]: Support direct video upload to LLM

question: Should OpenClaw support provider-native video as a first-class chat/model input, and if so through which core/plugin contract and raw-media egress policy?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix crosses product API shape, provider routing, model capability metadata, storage/retention limits, provider egress, and fallback behavior that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Approve first-class chat video input
options.body: Define a coherent WebChat/Gateway/model-catalog/provider contract with security limits and then land or replace the implementation accordingly.

options.title: Keep video in media-understanding only
options.body: Defer direct chat/model video uploads and document the supported video.description media-understanding path instead.

options.title: Narrow provider-specific proofs first
options.body: Let providers prove native video behavior behind provider-owned seams before adding a generic core chat-video content contract.

recommendation.title: Approve first-class chat video input
recommendation.body: Define a coherent WebChat/Gateway/model-catalog/provider contract with security limits and then land or replace the implementation accordingly.
